items.status: OPEN — filed 2026-10-02 (the owner: "`.state()` doesn't lease the remote source so it currently never resolves to a value")
items.title: `TransientSource::state()` on a mirror REPORTS without leasing (std's documented contract), so `client.get_x().state()` stays `Pending` forever unless something else leases — a footgun; and `TransientState` has no `map`
items.discussion: the owner (2026-10-02, kolt `model.vl`); A142 S3 / `reactive-layers.md` §5 (R25–R28: `state()` the read-only face; `latest()`/`is_pending()` fresh pipes that lease); `rpc.vl` `RemoteSource::state` (`register_with_owner` over the cache and the mint, no lease), `latest()` (`combine((leased, told))`)
items.body: kolt now spells the leasing form by hand (`transient_of`: the mirror as a `dyn Source` combined with `status()`, re-read as `transient_state()`) and a local `map_state`. Rec: (a) `state()` on a mirror should LEASE like `latest()` does — a state nobody can observe resolving is not a state; if R28's 'read-only face' must stay passive, add `states(): dyn Pipe<TransientState<T, E>>` beside `latest()`/`is_pending()` and make `state()`'s doc shout; (b) `TransientState::map(self, |T| U)` (and `and_then`?) in std, since every consumer re-matches five arms. Also the explicit `switch<TransientState<..>>` binding kolt still needs (B480's shape — re-check on next; the pin may not cover a `match` of two `dyn Flow` arms). Sizing S; reactive lane, Order 46.
